policy.completionRule: The implementation plan is complete when L01-L08 pass with scoped local end-to-end evidence and reviewers.
policy.replayRule: Run acceptance checks from a fresh checkout using versioned or pinned inputs. Recreate generated inputs under verification/local/ in the current worktree. Use tracked results for historical evidence.

statusMeaning: Local end-to-end implementation is in progress. Component receipts retain their scope; no whole local gate is passed by the SDK or build-only results.

gates.name: Setup, adoption, and export
gates.requirement: Install from pinned public SDK/tooling inputs, create and import a Swift app, build and run on both local targets, and export a working independent build. FieldLog consumes public interfaces from its separate repository. Registry publication and outside developers are not prerequisites.

gates.name: Shared app and native UI
gates.requirement: FieldLog's supported screens, state, navigation, input, accessibility, shared design, persistence, and first-party capabilities work on both local targets. Record OS-specific limitations. Physical-only services use explicit test adapters for local orchestration, with actual hardware/provider behavior pending.

gates.name: Compiler and owned runtime
gates.requirement: Supported Swift features execute in native and guest modes through the owned engine with actionable source diagnostics. Conformance, differential, malformed-input, cancellation, and resource-limit checks pass. Measure responsiveness, memory, and update size on the stated local workload. Hardware budgets remain separately unqualified.
gates.reviewer: Independent L03 installed current-VM review, l03-local-gate-installed-close-ed49632895

gates.name: Safe OTA and recovery
gates.requirement: A locally served, signed logic and UI update changes both already-installed apps without reinstall. Compatibility, tenant/app identity, signatures, replay, cohorts, key rotation, and unsupported native changes are enforced. Interrupted or failed updates recover offline with saved data intact. Use development keys, never production signing credentials.
gates.reviewer: Independent L04 exact shared native success review, l04-shared-native-success-exact-review-838085d6e0

gates.name: Local platform workflow
gates.requirement: Real console, CLI, Phoenix API, PostgreSQL, Oban workers, build workers, artifact delivery, and separate development signer complete onboarding, build, logs, cancellation, update, promotion, and rollback locally. Test store request/status/error handling against documented provider fixtures. Actual uploads, store processing, provider infrastructure, and distribution remain pending.

gates.name: Free accounts and administration
gates.requirement: Free organizations can use the full testing workflow without a card, subscription, Stripe credentials, or payment service. Memberships, permissions, usage visibility, quotas, support, export, and deletion work locally. Paid plans, invoices, payment collection, paid entitlements, and purchase integrations may remain unimplemented and inactive.
gates.reviewer: Independent L06 acceptance and maintained-replay reviewers, with root verification of the fixture verdict correction

gates.name: Security and local reliability
gates.requirement: Provenance, licensing notices, VM/bridge/update verification, signer separation, tenant isolation, privacy, authorization, and local fault/restore tests pass. Resolve findings that compromise the supported local workflow. Test local service/worker loss and recovery. Production SLOs, provider failover, and staffed operations are later qualification.
gates.reviewer: Independent L07 signed runtime audit and ordinary iOS privacy review, l07-final-local-privacy-complete-json-5e731cdae4

gates.name: FieldLog and documentation
gates.requirement: Run the complete supported FieldLog workflow through public tooling on both targets, including edit/save/close/reopen, offline queue, attachments, guest parity, OTA, rollback, and export. Exercise the applicable Section 22 recovery and real-change corpus locally. Follow installation, upgrade, recovery, and exit guides from a clean local setup. Store use, customer counts, and paid pilots are not required.
